## Konoha Henge

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/item_leaf.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

While in a bake-danuki form, the user writes the name of an object on a leaf, and the leaf becomes it for a while, a wooden, stone or iron tool or sword, a shield, a bow, arrows, torches, ladders or blocks. It never leaves their inventory and turns back into a leaf, and so does a block they place with it The ability mode key changes what is written, and "Blocks" copies the block they look at

<div class="entry-stats" markdown="1">

| Stat | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Cooldown | 30 s (600 ticks) |
| Conditional cooldown | 0.5 s (10 ticks) |
| Pack multiplier when dealing damage | 1.65× |

</div>

## Bunshin no Ha

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/clone_leaf.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

While in a bake-danuki form, the user writes the name of someone they have seen on a leaf, and the leaf becomes a loyal clone of them for 30 seconds, with half their health and strength and two of their abilities Whoever the user looks at is remembered. The ability mode key opens the memory, where the one to copy is chosen

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/attack_leaf.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

## Bake no Ha

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/bake_disguise.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

While in a bake-danuki form, the user puts a leaf on their head and takes the look of a creature or player they have seen, for 60 seconds. The look falls when they hit or are hit. Taking a look ends the form Whoever the user looks at is remembered. The ability mode key opens the memory, where the look is chosen

## Henge

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/henge.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

While in a bake-danuki form, the user turns into an object. As an umbrella they float down slowly for 10 seconds and turn aside the shots coming at them from the front. As a giant brush they rush ahead, striking every foe on the stroke and leaving a trail of ink The ability mode key switches between the umbrella and the brush
